recipes.name: Baked Delicata Squash with Lime Butter
ingredients_raw: 1 teaspoon chili powder, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Place squash, skin-side up, into a large baking dish. Fill the dish with 1/4 inch water.
Bake in the preheated oven until squash pierces easily with a fork, about 30 minutes.
When the squash is almost finished, blend butter with lime juice and chili powder in a small bowl. Mix in lime zest, salt, and pepper.
Remove squash from the oven, flip, and spoon butter mixture into the cavities. Serve immediately.

raw_recipe.headline: Baked Delicata Squash with Lime Butter
raw_recipe.description: This baked delicata squash is tender and mellow and drizzled with a chili-flavored lime butter.

review.reviewBody: I give this five stars because it is the best combination of ingredients I have tried for Delicata squash. This is NOT the kind of vegetable that tastes good mashed up with vanilla, cream and cinnamon like pumpkin or sweet potato - (believe me, I tried cooking many ways this morning)The lime and spice bring out the flavor the best. You can add a dash of cayenne if you like. Had to upload my picture after cooking - Thanks! P.S. The SEEDS are great too. I rinsed and dried them, then baked at 275 for about 30 min. Next, heat up a tsp or less of olive oil in a pan and add lime juice, salt, chili and cayenne pepper to taste. Mix in your seeds and cook for a minute or less. Spread on paper towel and allow to dry before storing.

wow- really didn't think this would be that great- but it was a perfect flavor to compliment the squash. i cook the squash in the microwave 'cause it goes faster (pierce a few times with knife & cover with plastic wrap.) then after it has cooked & cooled a bit i cut in half and removed seeds. also, used lemon juice instead of lime 'cause that's what i have around & it still was perfect (in my opinion). can't wait to make again!!!

Loced the flavor. My oven was busy cooking at 400 degrees, so I cooked the squash in microwave for 8 min first, dovered with plastic wrap, then uncovered, drained, turned over, added lime butter and finished in oven at 400 for 10 minutes or so. It was tender and seasoning was bright and just right.

I had a delicata sitting on my counter and decided to use it today. My husband who likes all food sweet wanted a brown sugar, butter adn cinnamon sauce, so I made that for his half and decided to try the lime butter on mine. It was OUTSTANDING. I really thought I would not like this, but it was so good, I kept wishing my husband hadn't eaten his so I could put the lime butter on his half and devour it. A really pleasant surprise.

And as I always do the first time, didn't change the recipe at all and it did take 30 minutes to cook. Perfection.

I just made this and filled the squash cavity with brown rice, but I think it would be even better with quinoa in the middle. Like some others, I let the squash go for about 45 min so the rice and squash were ready at the same time. Next time I might stir a dash of hot sauce in with the chili-lime butter, but this was so great and a welcome change from brown sugar or maple syrup. Thanks, FarmMom!

I thought this was great! 4 stars rating is only because Hubby didn't like it. I made it with greek yoghurt instead of butter (after realizing we were out of butter when the squash was already in the oven!) which turned out absolutely delicious - and makes for a healthier alternative.
I substituted cumin & season salt for the chili powder because we can't tolerate the heat in chili powder & used a vegan butter replacement.
I did everything the same except I put shredded mozzarella cheese in it. Will do this again.

I have made this a few times and is always so good! Delicata is such a unique squash and the textural differences in the meat and the cooked skin within one bite is what makes this such a great dish. It is a seasonal squash, so when I see it in the store, I always get some while I can! I like to add more chili powder and cayenne for the heat, but great as written.

We liked the lime butter (I actually used lemon juice and lime zest) but 30 min wasn't long enough for the squash. It was a bit annoying trying to scoop the buttery squash out at the table, so next time we try this I will scoop and mash it ahead of time and mix the butter into that.

Hard to beat the combination of simplicity and flavor in this recipe. I used 50% more squash, 100% more lime juice and got pretty good results. I also used Jamaican jerk-seasoning rather than chili powder. You can take this in a dozen directions and not screw it up.
So good! Nice savory alternative to all the sweet recipes out there. I was out of lime so used Yuzu juice instead.
This was my first time making delicata and I love this recipe!
OMG! Sooo yummy! I had never heard of Delicata Squash 2 weeks ago before receiving one in my first Misfits Market box. I used cayenne pepper instead of chili powder. I’ll definitely make this again!
Easy and yummy! A bee fall favorite!
A great alternative to sweet squash recipes. Very easy to make and if you use delicata squash, you have portion control. Half of a squash is a just right for a single serving.
Follow directions to the tee. Excellent!
Very good. BUT, I added 1 T or so of maple syrup. The lime was a little to dominant for my tastes. The Maple syrup toned it down.
This was very good! I melted the butter (about 2/3 of what recipe called for) , but all of us really liked the fresh lime, zest& chili powder.

I am very pleased with this recipe. It turned out delicious. My children really enjoyed it too. My son and I had fun making our own chili powder for it.
I stuck to the recipe, just doubled it and I absolutely will be making this again! Thanks for posting this recipe.
